name: Aquarium 51
source:
You play as the newest intern at a marine wildlife rehabilitation center that can best be described as… unusual. After four years working on your degree, there’s just one more thing to do - complete your senior internship! Meet your coworkers, explore the aquarium, and help keep this struggling establishment from going under - even if people keep dodging your questions about those eerie sounds coming from the basement.

[From [url=https://eggdadde.itch.io/aquarium-51]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演海洋野生动物康复中心的最新实习生，这个中心可以用“不寻常”来形容。经过四年的学位学习后，还有一件事要做 - 完成你的高级实习！与你的同事见面，探索水族馆，并帮助防止这个苦苦挣扎的机构破产——即使人们一直回避你关于地下室传来的怪异声音的问题。

[来自[url=https://eggdadde.itch.io/aquarium-51]itch.io[/url]]
